scope: Four ordinary-account token-quote SellV3 cases isolating base-balance versus quote-authority validation order. Requires root review before any VM run.

cases.name: sell-v3-token-valid
cases.expectation_status: static prediction only; original actual result governs

cases.name: sell-v3-token-balance-only
cases.expectation_status: static prediction only; original actual result governs

cases.name: sell-v3-token-quote-authority-only
cases.expectation_status: static prediction only; original actual result governs

cases.name: sell-v3-token-combined
cases.expectation_status: static prediction only; original actual result governs

account_constraints: Never change owner or executable flags. Retain captured base mint authority, total supply, base-vault amount and base-user amount.
Create ordinary initialized quote SPL mint and canonical curve/user/buyback token accounts using the approved token-positive builder; preserve mint and token authority bytes.

For the malformed-authority cases only, point the instruction associated_quote_user meta at the existing curve quote ATA. That account stays owned by Tokenkeg with valid mint and curve authority. No account data or owner mutation is needed.
Use the existing normally signed user, ordinary funding, and captured dependencies; no RPC or live-chain operation.
Use 500000000 base units for sufficient-balance cases and1000000001 for insufficient-balance cases, exactly one unit beyond the captured1000000000 user balance.
verification: Record complete transaction/prestate/Clock and signatures before execution.
Run original, unchanged R47 and proposed source candidate only after root authorizes each candidate. Original errors and ordering govern; never force predictions.
Require paired state, CPI, event, return-data and ordered-log outcomes for the corrected candidate. Confirm failure paths leave transaction state unchanged.
Keep all four cases as qualification inputs until transaction+prestate+Clock deduplication against the admitted corpus is complete.
limits: No build or transaction has been performed.
This isolates one caller precedence gap; it does not claim reconstruction of the complete7f010helper or all account-admission behavior.
